findings.title: Vulnerable dependency lodash@4.17.21
findings.message: lodash@4.17.21 is affected by GHSA-f23m-r3pf-42rh (lodash vulnerable to Prototype Pollution via array path bypass in `_.unset` and `_.omit`). Reachable via benchmark > lodash. (dev-only)
findings.remediation: Upgrade lodash to 4.18.0 or later (data from OSV).

fix.diff:
--- a/package.json
+++ b/package.json
# bump lodash from 4.17.21 to 4.18.0
